result.topic_en: Scratch calculations on a Dirichlet-type integral $\mathfrak{L}$ (sum of squared partial derivatives) for test functions such as $(\log\varrho)^\alpha$ near a point and $\sqrt{1-x^2}$, with sketches of domains with slits and holes, inequalities involving curvature $\kappa$ and normal distance $p$, and tables of fractions/continued-fraction-like expressions in $x$ (some written upside down).
